name: actors
body: Actor roles: the domain representation of each individual who acts on kalide — the deck author, the template author and the maintainer. Each actor entity is the same individual as its requirements.user.* counterpart and its solution.person.* counterpart; the actor tier is linked by `represents` (requirements.user.* -> domain.entity.* -> solution.person.*). The group exists because the binary's `represents` schema allows only `requirements.user -> domain.entity` and `domain.entity -> solution.person` — a direct user->person edge is refused — so the user<->person identity must pass through a domain actor entity. The group contains the three actor entities (the CLI binary for the two authors, the release pipeline for the maintainer were the roles' operating elements, not their realisation), which are anchored to the solution tier only through `represents` -> solution.person.*, not `realised-by`: the actor identity is carried by `represents` (whose entity->person half targets the solution person), and there are no realised-by edges on the group or its entities, because a person is not realised by software.
